chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim narrated from Ali ibn Ja'far, from his brother, from his father, from their ancestors, peace be upon them, who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to throw the Jamarat while walking.

key_terms.رَمْيِ الْجِمَارِ: Ramy al-Jamarat (throwing pebbles at the pillars)

ai.seo_question: Did the Prophet throw the Jamarat while walking or riding?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith from the Ahl al-Bayt chain of narration establishes the Sunnah of performing Ramy al-Jamarat on foot, emphasizing physical humility and adherence to the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) practice. This ruling is significant in Shia jurisprudence for distinguishing between the recommended method (walking) and the permissible alternative (riding), reflecting the balance between ritual ease and devotional intensity.
